decision: Promote the Nano Banana Pro starter into a VIZIGROK compaction packet instead of leaving it as a bare automation repo.
reason: The user asked to change the automation into a VIZIGROK compaction; the project needs rehydration, routing, schema, and handoff surfaces.

decision: Treat Key.ai as a likely spoken form of Kie.ai until confirmed.
reason: The existing scaffold targets Kie.ai; provider ambiguity is captured as an open question rather than silently branching.

decision: Make HTML a living cockpit, not the source of truth.
reason: VIZIGROK/VIZIMAP style prefers HTML for inspection while preserving JSONL/YAML/Markdown as canonical trails.

decision: Extract build_task_payload from create_nano_banana_pro_task to enable unit testing and dry-run mode without HTTP mocking.
reason: Separating payload construction (pure, testable) from HTTP dispatch lets tests verify validation and payload shape directly, and lets --dry-run print the exact payload a real submit would send.

decision: Add --dry-run to submit and submit-yaml only; not to batch or poll.
reason: Batch and poll have different flows where dry-run semantics are ambiguous. Scope to the two single-job submit paths where it is unambiguous and most useful for development.
